description: This file contains CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for managing test file records in a database, including functions to get, create, update, and delete test files, with handling for duplicates and specific search criteria.

methods.name: get_test_file
methods.description: Retrieve a test file by its ID from the database.

methods.name: get_test_file_by_uid
methods.description: Retrieve a test file by its UUID.

methods.name: get_test_file_by_storage_path
methods.description: Retrieve a test file by its storage path.

methods.name: get_test_files
methods.description: Retrieve a list of test files with optional pagination.

methods.name: create_test_file
methods.description: Create a new test file record in the database.

methods.name: create_test_file_safe
methods.description: Create a test file with duplicate handling; returns None if duplicate exists.

methods.name: update_test_file
methods.description: Update an existing test file record.

methods.name: delete_test_file
methods.description: Delete a test file record by ID.
